_doc: Bang thuat ngu KHONG duoc dich - dung boi check_style.py.
Moi muc la mot mau SAI cu the, KHONG phai bang 'Anh -> Viet'. Ly do: thu
can BIET lai mot ban dich sai, khong phai sua mot ban dich dung. Gia tri
'term' chi de bao cao cho nguoi doc hieu vi sao.
{'vi': regex, 'src': regex}      - chi sai khi NGUON khop 'src'
Loai thu hai la bat buoc voi cac cap le thuoc ngu canh:
Bypass -> 'bo qua'  nhung  Ignore/Skip/Discard -> 'bo qua' la DUNG
Cycle  -> 'lap'     nhut  Repeat  -> 'lap lai'           la DUNG
Mot mau vo dieu kien se chan 23 chuoi dung va do la bao dong gia.
Moi mau duoi day da duoc do tren 10.737 chuoi va bao 0 vi pham. Mau nao
ban vao giao dien thi khong duoc them - AGENT.md §7: bo do bao dong gia
nhieu lan con te hon khong co bo do.

_keep_english_doc: Danh sach nay KHONG doan. Moi tu da duoc do tren 10.737 chuoi: nguon
co tu do tu >=5 lan, va ban dich DICH no <=2 lan. Tuc la ban dich da coi
no la tu khong dich duoc - chi la chua duoc viet vao luat, nen dot sau
co the pha ma khong ai bao. 90 tu da co trong 70 tu cua AGENT.md §2.
Da loai: viet tat (OMF/AAF/SMF/Sysex), thuong hieu (Steinberg/Yamaha/
Nuendo), tu tieng Anh binh thuong (Menu/Post/Take/True), ten nhac cu va
the loai (Jazz/Conga/Tom-tom), va nhung tu dang phan van (xem duoi).
_not_in_forbidden_because_ambiguous: Nhung cap le thuoc ngu canh, khong the thanh luat vo dieu kien:
'bo qua' -> 23 chuoi dung (Ignore/Skip/Discard) - da xu ly bang src
'lap'    -> 18 chuoi dung (Repeat/Loop)          - da xu ly bang src
Nhung cap THUC SU xung dot, phai nguoi quyet dinh chu khong the tu dong:
'Time Signature' -> 49 chuoi dang dich 'so chi nhip' (0 chuoi giu)
'Version'        -> 26 chuoi dich 'phien ban' (nguon la 'program version' - dung trong cau)
Them luat cho chung se chan hang chuc chuoi dang lam dung. Chung thuoc
AGENT.md §2 dang 'giu tieng Anh' - vet chinh la §2, khong phai bo do.
